about: Say hello. The model fails with a server error, the harness retries once and the turn fails.

known.reason: Devin 3000.11.205 keeps nothing of a turn its model failed: its store holds the prompt with no reply, error or stop, and its replay sends none. The failure reached its client only live, as `_cognition.ai/agent_stopped` with cause `error` once its retries ran out.

Mako sums up the retries it watched on the wire (Devin's `_cognition.ai/connection_retry` notices) in one marker; Devin 3000.11.205 keeps none of those notices in its stores and its replay sends none, so only the live drawing has the measure (RETRY_MARKERS, declared stream-only).
